source.speaker: Vas Narasimhan（诺华 CEO）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: I think one important dynamic is the strong launch in HS is supporting us in our core indications of psoriasis, PSA, and AS.

source.speaker: Vas Narasimhan（诺华 CEO）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: We're seeing increased diagnosis and desire to treat amongst physicians and patients, which I think will allow the HS market to grow to larger than it's historically been.

source.speaker: Vas Narasimhan（诺华 CEO）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: In HS, we're seeing a very strong uptake with market leadership, a share over 60% in the NBRX.

source.speaker: Vas Narasimhan（诺华 CEO）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: And I think importantly, with the launch of Cosentyx, we're seeing increased diagnosis and desire to treat amongst physicians and patients, which I think will allow the HS market to grow to larger than it's historically been, and of course, allow Cosentyx to help these patients achieve their treatment goals.

source.speaker: Vas Narasimhan（诺华 CEO）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: For forecasting purposes, we continue to assume an Entresto LOE in mid-2025.

source.speaker: Vas Narasimhan（诺华 CEO）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: However, we continue to enforce our patents and litigate our patents, and we'll ensure that we maximize this brand for as long as possible in the United States, alongside EU RDP in November of 2026.

source.speaker: Vas Narasimhan（诺华 CEO）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: When you look at the demand growth by geography, the U.S. grew 34%, driven by volume.

source.speaker: Vas Narasimhan（诺华 CEO）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: When you look at the dynamics on Pluvicto, so we have, let's say, roughly 425 centers, and about a third of those centers, we were really well established.

source.speaker: Vas Narasimhan（诺华 CEO）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: This was broad-based in terms of its geographic growth profile.

source.speaker: Vas Narasimhan（诺华 CEO）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: So first, in terms of the study design, the way we designed the pelacarsen study was to look at two different levels of Lp(a).

source.speaker: Vas Narasimhan（诺华 CEO）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: As you know, historically, only anti-TNF adalimumab was the only medicine available, biologic medicine available for these patients.

source.speaker: Vas Narasimhan（诺华 CEO）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: As you know, Sjogren's, again, a relatively prevalent rheumatological disease without really any good treatment options.

source.speaker: 诺华管理层（原声）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: We certainly have, I think, proposals to all the key governments, and most important in my mind are Japan and Germany, but we haven't seen the progress that we need to see.

source.speaker: 诺华管理层（原声）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: And yet we know we need to constantly supplement that engine with additional external innovation.

source.speaker: Vas Narasimhan（诺华 CEO）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: The last third of centers are much more in the community, and here the dynamics are where we have to just do more work.

source.speaker: 诺华管理层（原声）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: We also see a higher number of competitors entering in each segment as well, which is something we have to just be ready for when we do launch in China.

source.speaker: Vas Narasimhan（诺华 CEO）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: So we're confident we're going to get there step by step, but it will take time.

source.speaker: 诺华管理层（原声）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: I think importantly as well, we're going to be looking at additional functional outcomes, such as the quantitative muscle testing and patient reporter-reported outcomes, as well as the 10-meter walk and run test.

source.speaker: Vas Narasimhan（诺华 CEO）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: And I think if we can show even higher levels, that would certainly create a lot of motivation in physicians to make sure these patients are tested.

source.speaker: Vas Narasimhan（诺华 CEO）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: And I think if we can unlock that segment over the course of the coming months, we can continue to drive Pluvicto in the vision population to the multi-billion or roughly $2 billion potential we think there is.

source.speaker: 诺华管理层（原声）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: So I wouldn't want to over-interpret what we're seeing.

source.speaker: 诺华管理层（原声）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: So overall, the dynamics in China, we've seen a stabilization in the early part of this year.

source.speaker: 诺华管理层（原声）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: So, taken together, we think that was the right decision, and everything that we've seen since completing the acquisition continues to confirm that.

source.speaker: Vas Narasimhan（诺华 CEO）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: We'll be launching a DTC campaign in quarter three.

source.speaker: 诺华管理层（原声）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: And obviously, once we see that data, we'll be able to provide better guidance on that use.

source.speaker: 诺华管理层（原声）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: Once we have that OS data, we should be able to file in Europe and then expand the patient population there.

source.speaker: 诺华管理层（原声）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: And we do believe that at 75 milligrams, we do have full target engagement and we should be able to achieve efficacy that approaches the 100 milligram dose.

source.speaker: Vas Narasimhan（诺华 CEO）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: A lot of it is education.

source.speaker: 诺华管理层（原声）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: So there's a lot of work to do.

source.speaker: Vas Narasimhan（诺华 CEO）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: And then we have about a third of sites of the 475 treatment sites that we are operating in, where we need to now get from 10% of share of the VISION population, hopefully up over time now to 50%, 90%.

source.speaker: Vas Narasimhan（诺华 CEO）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: And then lastly, we have German pricing approved, which is why you've seen the uplift in the ex-US market, ex-US sales profile.

source.speaker: Vas Narasimhan（诺华 CEO）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: So those are, of course, cardiovascular specialty groups, but also when you think about interventional cardiology, I mean, there are certain specialty groups we're learning that have a higher propensity to look for these biomarkers and then treat in order to avoid the recurrence of events, also given the push towards healthcare quality around the world.

source.speaker: 诺华管理层（原声）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: This was driven by strong EU uptake, but also, I think, a notable solid start in Japan, where we're seeing very strong interest in Pluvicto.

source.speaker: Vas Narasimhan（诺华 CEO）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: And of course, allow Cosentyx to help these patients achieve their treatment goals.

source.speaker: Vas Narasimhan（诺华 CEO）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: But of course, we have aspirations to get even higher.

source.speaker: 诺华管理层（原声）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: We do expect a readout in the early part of the second half of the year, so no change with respect to that.

source.speaker: 诺华管理层（原声）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: I think with respect to PCSK9s, I believe they've also been in line with what we saw earlier in the study, but we can follow up with the details.

source.speaker: 诺华管理层（原声）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: …which we're looking forward to reading out next year.

source.speaker: 诺华管理层（原声）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: Solid first half of the year and looking forward to continued progress in the months ahead.

source.speaker: 诺华管理层（原声）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: Kisqali is a brand we expect to have continued strong momentum over the course of this year.

source.speaker: 诺华管理层（原声）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: So we expect to be stable in that 50% range.

source.speaker: 诺华管理层（原声）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: So we want to see this market expand so the patients who need better therapies are getting them.

source.speaker: 诺华管理层（原声）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: We want to move into the adolescent population, and FDA would surely ask us to use the minimum required dose to achieve the efficacy required.

source.speaker: Vas Narasimhan（诺华 CEO）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: So we're trying to take a very targeted approach in how we think about our Lp(a) launch.

source.speaker: 诺华管理层（原声）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: But we're trying to stay really disciplined on the gross-to-net here.

source.speaker: Vas Narasimhan（诺华 CEO）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: We have another group of sites where we're working to go from 50% to 90%.

source.speaker: Vas Narasimhan（诺华 CEO）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: And over time, we expect robust uptake in other European markets.

source.speaker: 诺华管理层（原声）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: And certainly, we have the aspiration to make Leqvio as big or bigger than Entresto over time.

source.speaker: 诺华管理层（原声）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: And going forward, our focus will be very much continuing to expand Kisqali's utilization in those early breast cancer populations.

source.speaker: 诺华管理层（原声）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: And I think, Graham, when you look going forward, yeah, we continue to expect to be in this mid-single-digit range globally.

source.speaker: 诺华管理层（原声）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: At the same time, we continue to invest in our internal R&D pipeline.

source.speaker: Vas Narasimhan（诺华 CEO）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: I would say we're seeing very robust uptake in Germany, and over time, we expect robust uptake in other European markets.

source.speaker: 诺华管理层（原声）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: I would say that is our current working assumption.

source.speaker: 分析师（提问原声）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: Could you give us some color on how you see the HS opportunity going forward as it seems that you are gaining new patients, you have a new treatment, more potent than the existing one, but there will be also new entrants in the coming years.

source.speaker: 分析师（提问原声）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: Could you walk us through some of the competitive dynamics you're seeing in the US?

source.speaker: 分析师（提问原声）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: And then can you talk about barriers to uptake of Lp(a)-targeting agents?

source.speaker: 分析师（提问原声）
source.textType: 本地语音识别听写稿，非官方逐字稿；以录音为准

text: Can you talk about the P&L dynamics?
